pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions; only scale in when initial position achieves +$3.00 unrealized profit and ATR contraction confirms trend continuation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require order flow imbalance confirmation via tick volume delta exceeding 2.5x the 20-period moving average prior to execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stop activation at +$5.00 profit, locking in a minimum of +$3.00 while allowing runners to target +$15.00-$30.00.
